payroll.title: Employee Payroll
payroll.subtitle: Manage monthly payroll runs, allowances, deductions and payslips
common.name: Name
common.deleteMsg: “{name}” will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
dash.title: Dashboard
dash.subtitle: An overview of company performance
clients.title: Clients
clients.subtitle: All company clients and their balances
clients.name: Client name
clients.search: Search by name, business or phone
clients.emptyHint: Start by adding your first client to record invoices
clients.deleteBlocked: A client with invoices cannot be deleted. Delete their invoices first.
clients.noInvoices: No invoices for this client yet
employees.title: Employees
employees.subtitle: Employee records and their ledgers
employees.name: Employee name
employees.emptyHint: Add an employee to link them to clients and invoices
employees.deleteBlocked: An employee linked to clients or invoices cannot be deleted.
employees.commissionHint: Default commission percentage on employee sales
employees.targetAmountHint: Target threshold (e.g. 50,000) to trigger commission or tiering
employees.requireTargetForCommission: Require reaching target before earning commission
employees.requireTargetHint: No commission is calculated until employee sales hit the target amount
employees.overTargetEnable: Enable separate commission rate for sales above target
employees.overTargetHint: Calculate a different commission rate on the sales portion exceeding the target threshold
services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Packages and services with their prices
services.name: Service name
services.emptyHint: Add services such as UGC video, design, media buying, infographics
invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.subtitle: All client invoices and their collection status
invoices.lockedByTax: This invoice carries tax — its main amount and prices are locked. You can still edit item names, payment method, follow-up date and notes.
invoices.clientAccountHint: The number or account the client transferred from
invoices.emptyHint: Create your first invoice for one of your clients
invoices.search: Search by invoice number or client
invoices.overpaid: Collected exceeds the total — the client is in credit
expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Everything the company spends and why
expenses.treasuryHint: The cash box or bank account the money left
expenses.emptyHint: Record expenses so they reflect in net profit
expenses.autoHint: This expense came from an employee ledger entry and is edited there
reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Choose a period to view results
settings.title: Lists & Settings
settings.subtitle: The lists that appear across the other screens
settings.systemLocked: A core category used by the system and cannot be deleted
settings.inUse: Used in {count} records — archive it instead of deleting
error.rules.title: Firestore security rules are not deployed
error.rules.body: The database is currently rejecting reads and writes. Deploy firestore.rules to the Firebase project (or paste its contents into Firebase Console → Firestore → Rules) to enable saving data.
services.adBudgetHint: Client money spent on ad platforms — kept separate from company fees, excluded from profit, and not subject to discount or tax
invoices.itemIsAdBudget: This line is ad budget (client money), not a fee
invoices.adBudgetNote: Ad budget is collected on the client’s behalf and is not counted as company profit.
expenses.forClientHint: Pick the client if this spend comes from their ad budget, so it is excluded from company profit
reports.adsNote: These are client funds earmarked for advertising — neither revenue nor expense for the agency, and net profit is calculated without them.
settings.isAdSpendHint: Expenses in this category will ask which client budget funded them, and are excluded from company profit
invoices.collectHint: Record what the client paid right now. Leave it empty for a credit invoice — you can collect the rest later from the “Collect” button.
receipts.title: Receipt
receipts.hint: Pick the client and enter the amount paid. It is allocated across their outstanding invoices oldest first — you can adjust the split or assign it to one specific invoice.
receipts.noOutstanding: This client has no outstanding invoices
receipts.overAllocated: Allocated more than the amount collected
acct.title: Chart of Accounts
acct.subtitle: Account tree, journal and financial statements
acct.emptyTree: The chart of accounts has not been created yet
acct.emptyTreeHint: Start from a ready-made tree designed for a media agency — assets, liabilities, equity, revenue and expenses. You can rename and extend it afterwards.
acct.codeAutoHint: Auto-generated from the parent account — editable
acct.searchAccount: Search by code or account name
acct.searchEntry: Search by reference, description or account
acct.notBalanced: Out of balance — review the linked accounts in Settings
acct.noMovements: No movements recorded for this account in the selected period
settings.linkedAccount: Linked account in the chart of accounts
settings.linkedAccountHint: Leave it automatic and a dedicated account is created for it (under Cash or Banks & Wallets) so you can see its own balance in Treasury, or pick an existing account yourself
vendors.title: Vendors & freelancers
vendors.subtitle: Models, videographers, editors and designers, and what they are owed
vendors.defaultRateHint: Pre-fills when adding a cost; you can still change it
vendors.noJobs: No jobs recorded for them yet
vendors.search: Search by name, specialty or phone
vendors.empty: No vendors or freelancers added yet
vendors.emptyHint: Add the models, videographers, editors and designers you work with, so you know what each is owed
costs.title: Job costs & profitability
costs.vendorHint: Optional — leave empty if the cost is not tied to a person
costs.empty: No costs recorded on this invoice — the profit shown is the full revenue
reports.profitabilityNote: Revenue minus direct job costs (models, filming, design, equipment rental, commissions) — not general company overheads.
vouchers.title: Journal & vouchers
vouchers.subtitle: Opening balances, manual entries, payment and receipt vouchers
vouchers.emptyHint: Start with opening balances if the company was trading before this system
vouchers.needAccounts: Create the chart of accounts first
vouchers.needAccountsHint: Go to Accounting and press “Create default chart” before recording any entry
vouchers.debitHint: The account the money goes into
vouchers.creditHint: The account the money comes out of
vouchers.hint.manual: A free entry for anything without an automatic document — an adjustment, a correction, a bad debt, depreciation. Total debit must equal total credit.
vouchers.hint.opening: Balances at the start: cash on hand and in the bank, old client debts, what you owe vendors, and capital. Without these the balance sheet is incomplete.
vouchers.hint.drawing: Money you take out of the company for yourself. This is not an expense — it reduces equity so your profit stays accurate.
vouchers.hint.payment: A cash payment to a vendor, an expense or any party, with a numbered document.
vouchers.hint.receipt: Cash received that is not tied to a client invoice — other income or a refund.
vouchers.hint.tax: Paying the tax due to the authority; it clears the “Tax payable” balance.
vouchers.hint.transfer: Move money between cash, banks and wallets — the total does not change.
treasury.title: Cash & banks
treasury.subtitle: The current balance of every cash box, wallet and bank account
treasury.transferHint: Move money from one account to another — e.g. withdrew from the bank into the cash box. Total cash does not change.
treasury.emptyHint: Create the chart of accounts, then link your transfer methods to their accounts in Lists & Settings
invoices.cancelHint: Cancelling keeps the invoice and posts a reversing entry dated today — the accounting-correct approach, rather than deleting and erasing the trail.
users.title: Users & permissions
users.subtitle: Who can sign in, and what each person may see and do
users.activeLabel: Account is active and can sign in
users.usernameHint: A short name without spaces — they will sign in with it, like admin
users.passwordHint: At least 6 characters — hand it over and have them change it
users.deleteMsg: “{name}” will be removed from the system and can no longer sign in. The login account itself is removed from the Firebase Console.
users.err.weak: Password must be at least 6 characters
users.err.generic: Could not create the user, please try again
users.roleDesc.admin: Everything — including user management and settings
users.roleDesc.accountant: All accounting, invoices, expenses, payroll and reports — but not user management
users.roleDesc.sales: Clients, invoices and services only — no profits, payroll or expenses
users.roleDesc.viewer: Can view clients, invoices and reports without changing anything
bootstrap.title: Set up the first administrator
bootstrap.body: This is the first time permissions have been opened. Register yourself as the administrator so you can add the rest of the users. This happens only once.
bootstrap.error: Could not save. Make sure the Firestore rules are deployed and try again.
noaccess.title: You do not have access
noaccess.body: This account is not registered in the system, or it has been suspended. Ask an administrator to add or reactivate you.
employees.commissionHint: A percentage of the fees on every invoice they own — calculated automatically. Leave empty for no commission.
invoices.commissionNote: Recorded automatically as a cost on this invoice and shown in the employee's dues.
assets.title: Equipment & assets
assets.subtitle: Cameras, lenses and gear — their maintenance and current value
assets.name: Equipment name
assets.lifeHint: e.g. 36 months for a camera, 48 for a laptop — depreciation is based on this
assets.salvageHint: What you expect to sell it for. Leave zero if unsure.
assets.search: Search by name or serial number
assets.emptyHint: Record your cameras, lenses and gear to track their current value and maintenance
assets.noMaintenance: No maintenance recorded for this item
assets.nextDueHint: You will be alerted when the date arrives
assets.dueTitle: {count} maintenance jobs are due or overdue
assets.kindHint: Depreciable = depreciation posts · Fixed = no auto depreciation · Land = never depreciates
assets.componentsHint: Add the asset's components: body + lens + battery…
assets.depMethodHint: Straight-line / declining balance / units of production / none
assets.decliningRateHint: Leave empty to auto-calc (double the straight-line rate)
assets.totalUnitsHint: Total units the asset will produce over its life (hours/shots/km…)
assets.acquisitionAccountHint: The cash box, bank, or vendor account it was bought from
assets.assetAccountHint: The account the asset is booked to — important for land and fixed assets
quotes.title: Quotations & monthly retainers
quotes.subtitle: Work before it becomes an invoice, and recurring subscriptions
quotes.validHint: After this date the quote is flagged as expired
quotes.emptyHint: Send the client a quote, and turn it into an invoice in one click when they accept
quotes.retainerHint: A retainer repeats every month with the same items and price. The system reminds you at the start of the month and generates the invoices in one click — never twice for the same month.
quotes.billingDayHint: 1 to 28 — the day of the month the invoice is dated
quotes.endHint: Leave empty for an open-ended retainer
quotes.activeLabel: Retainer is running and billed monthly
quotes.dueTitle: {count} retainers are due for billing this month
quotes.dueHint: Press the button and the system creates all their invoices at once
quotes.noRetainersHint: If clients pay you a fixed monthly subscription, record them here and stop writing their invoice by hand every month
acct.missingTitle: {count} system accounts are missing from the chart
acct.missingHint: The chart was created before newer system accounts (commissions, vendors, depreciation) were added. Without them some entries are not posted and the trial balance appears unbalanced.
acct.err.codeExists: This account code is already in use
acct.err.nameExists: This account name is already in use
vouchers.missingAccount: A line has an amount but no account selected
quotes.search: Search by quote number or client
employees.paidNowHint: Opens a numbered payment voucher and posts it as an expense immediately. Leave unchecked if this is accrued and will be paid later — you can mark it disbursed anytime by clicking the status.
costs.staffHint: This cost will appear in the employee's monthly statement as extra job pay on top of their salary.
services.costingHint: Everything this service costs end to end — direct and indirect — so you know the price floor and your true margin on it.
services.indirectHint: This service's expected share of rent, internet, electricity, lighting and equipment depreciation — you set it as an estimate.
invoices.expectedCostHint: Calculated from the selected services' cost × qty — the floor the price should not drop below.
costs.expectedTitle: Expected profit (standard cost from the service)
costs.actualTitle: Actual profit (costs recorded on the invoice)
employees.targetBonusEnable: Bonus when the employee beats the monthly target
employees.targetBonusHint: If the employee beats the target in any month, the bonus shows in their statement's net — record it as a “bonus” entry when you actually pay it.
reports.expectedNote: Revenue minus the expected standard cost stored on each invoice (from the services' cost at the time). Older invoices with no standard cost show zero cost.
campaigns.title: Ad campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: Each campaign's budget, agency fee, duration and daily spend rate
campaigns.name: Campaign name
campaigns.emptyHint: Record clients' ad campaigns to track budget, your fee and daily spend
campaigns.feeFromHint: "From budget" = client pays the budget, agency takes its cut from it · "On top" = client pays budget + fee
campaigns.onTopNote: Client pays the full budget to platforms plus the management fee on top.
campaigns.fromBudgetNote: Fee is deducted from the budget — the rest goes to platforms, the fee is agency revenue.
campaigns.notInvoiced: No invoice for this campaign yet — click "Create invoice"
managed.title: Manage list items
managed.seedHint: The list is empty — you can start from a ready set and edit it.
settings.logoHint: PNG or JPG — transparent background preferred, under 5 MB. Uploaded to Cloudinary.
settings.logoNotImage: That file is not an image
settings.websiteHint: Shown as a QR code on the printed invoice
settings.contractTermsHint: Fixed text printed in every invoice footer — payment, delivery, cancellation policy…
assets.acquisitionHint: Cash = leaves the cash box now · On credit = owed to the vendor
acct.tax.note: Output VAT is computed from invoice tax in the period. Input VAT on purchases is not tracked automatically — post it as a manual entry if you need to deduct it.
positions.title: Job Positions & Titles
positions.subtitle: Manage job titles, position codes, and associated departments
positions.name: Job Title
